Mandatory Copyright Notice: Copyright 2026 NBAESAN ANTONIO — The Spurs watched a double-digit second-half lead disappear Wednesday night as the New York Knicks rallied for a 105-95 victory in Game 1 of the NBA Finals.
San Antonio led by as many as 14 points in the third quarter and carried a 55-48 advantage into halftime before New York stormed back. The Knicks closed the third quarter on a 22-9 run to tie the game at 76 heading into the fourth. Victor Wembanyama led the Spurs with 26 points and 12 rebounds in his NBA Finals debut, while Stephon Castle added 17 points. Julian Champagnie and Dylan Harper each chipped in 16 points.
Despite struggling from the field, Wembanyama helped keep San Antonio in front late, and his pair of free throws with 2:16 remaining gave the Spurs a 95-94 lead. Jalen Brunson answered with a go-ahead 3-pointer on the next possession, sparking an 11-0 Knicks run to close the game. Brunson finished with 30 points, while Karl-Anthony Towns added 18 points and 12 rebounds.
The loss marked the first time in franchise history that the Spurs dropped Game 1 of an NBA Finals series. San Antonio entered the night 6-0 in Finals openers. Game 2 is set for Friday night in San Antonio, where the Spurs will look to even the series before it shifts to New York.
